items.title: The young people caught up in Britain's Neets crisis
items.summary: BBC News speaks to four of the million young people aged 16 to 24 who are not in work, education or training.

items.title: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
items.summary: Warren Arter used his position - running a team investigating sexual assaults - to target women.

items.title: Watch: Predatory Met detective's behaviour became increasingly extreme
items.summary: The Metropolitan Police repeatedly missed opportunities to stop det insp Warren Arter, BBC Panorama has found.

items.title: Cass report author says she does not support draft conversion practices bill
items.summary: The gender care review author says the bill’s wording risks "serious unintended consequences" for parents and therapists.

items.title: Crimea bridge shut after reported Ukrainian strike, as Russia hits Kyiv crossings
items.summary: The bridge linking Crimea and Russia has reportedly sustained major damage, while two routes through Kyiv are closed.

items.title: Met Office yellow warning in place as snow could disrupt Tuesday morning travel
items.summary: Snow could bring some transport disruption to the hills of northern England and southern Scotland, as Chris Fawkes explains.

items.title: Failed asylum seekers face removal without five-day notice period
items.summary: Under proposed new rules, the Home Office would have six months in which to remove a person without telling them in advance.

items.title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
items.summary: Efforts to recover bodies after a “double-tap” attack in southern Ukraine are being hampered by continuing Russian strikes, officials say.
